description: Land Title Settlememt Department - Batugedara, Rathnapura D/S Division, Rathnapura District - Cad. Map No. 620293 and others
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determinations by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, extents, ownership details, and land classifications. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses on land registration and title settlement processes, which clearly falls under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4).
